content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Stripe alternatives

The digital economy thrives on accessibility, but many creators in Nigeria and similar regions are sidelined by payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal. These platforms restrict service based on geographical location, which can be frustrating for creators eager to sell their work. When these platforms operate, they often do so with conditions that limit creators' autonomy, such as unpredictable fund holds or account suspensions. Understanding this infrastructure challenge is the first step toward building a more resilient and sovereign commerce strategy that empowers creators to operate independently and securely.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is built on free and open-source tools that provide a robust alternative to traditional payment systems. At its core, this architecture utilizes services like Cloudflare for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. This combination allows creators to have full control over their sales, eliminating reliance on third-party platforms. By leveraging these technologies, creators can host their digital products, process payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, and maintain ownership of their data, ensuring they are not locked out of their commerce.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in countries with limited access to traditional payment platforms. It empowers artists, educators, and entrepreneurs from Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and beyond to sell ebooks, courses, and other digital products. By eliminating barriers imposed by conventional payment systems, this infrastructure enables creators to operate freely, fostering innovation and creativity without the constraints of account restrictions or prolonged fund holds.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts you in control of your sales, not the platform.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign commerce stack work in harmony to create a seamless experience for digital creators. For instance, using Cloudflare Pages for hosting ensures fast and reliable access to product pages, while NOWPayments simplifies the checkout process with low transaction fees and no need for KYC. Additionally, tools like Supabase allow creators to manage their orders efficiently and securely. This integrated approach not only streamlines the selling process but also enhances the user experience for both creators and their customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start building your sovereign commerce infrastructure, first, choose a hosting service like Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up a backend using Google Apps Script to manage your transactions. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency payments, ensuring low fees and quick processing. Use Supabase to store and manage your product data and orders. Finally, upload your digital products and launch your store, allowing you to retain full control over your sales and customer relationships.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Cryptocurrency payments eliminate traditional banking barriers for creators.

By using tools like NOWPayments, you can start selling directly from your own store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore your options.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

You can sell digital products by using sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows you to host your own store and process payments via cryptocurrency. This removes reliance on platforms like Stripe and gives you full control over your sales.
What is the best alternative to Gumroad for creators in restricted countries?

A robust alternative to Gumroad for creators in restricted countries is the Edge Commerce Stack. It provides the necessary tools to create and manage your online store while allowing for cryptocurrency payments.
Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?

Using PayPal in these countries can be problematic due to account restrictions and potential fund holds. It's advisable to explore decentralized payment solutions that provide more stability and control.
What happens to my funds if my PayPal account gets suspended?
PayPal can hold funds for up to 180 days without appeal if your account is suspended. This makes it critical for creators to seek alternatives that ensure immediate access to their funds.
How can I ensure my digital products are secure and accessible?
Using a combination of secure hosting, reliable file storage, and automatic payment processing can ensure your digital products remain secure and accessible to customers at all times.
